description: Tests, offline dry-run, and final report (Part E). Adds 8 node:test files (registered in package.json's explicit `test` list), the offline X discovery dry-run demo + mock-X path in autoNewsDryRun.ts, runs the full verification sequence, and writes 06-final-report.md. Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-004 (all code must be in place). This is the last feature.
steps: tests/ranking/recencyQuality.test.ts (FIX via E.1(1)) — PARAMETERIZED matrix over ages [1,6,12,18,23]h x varied quality using computeRankedStory + hardFilter with injected now, NO LLM: (a) for two in-window items whose qualityScore gap exceeds the recency bound, the higher-quality item has the higher finalScore regardless of age; (b) when qualityScore is equal within a small epsilon, the FRESHER item wins (higher recencyMultiplier); (c) a 25h item is DROPPED by hardFilter (too_old).

tests/x/xHardFilter.test.ts — X items with outbound/long text + engagement survive; replies and reposts are always dropped; a bare no-source one-liner under minTextLength is dropped; an RSS short-summary item is still dropped by the RSS SUMMARY_TOO_SHORT rule (proving the branch).

tests/x/linkExpand.test.ts (FIX #1 ordering + FR-E3) — pure test of resolveOutboundUrls + normalizeScrapedPost over sample link data with an injected expander map (t.co -> destination), NO network; x.com/twitter.com dropped. Plus a TS mirror of the attach_thread_texts ordering logic over an ordered posts[] with dom_index: consecutive same-author grouping caps at 5; other-author runs yield [].

tests/x/failSoft.test.ts (FR-E4) — (i) inject a `search` returning { stopReason: 'login_wall' } (and captcha/http_429/empty-twice variants) into runDiscovery with stub gateways; assert aborted:true, escalating cooldown set, never throws; (ii) inject a SavedXPostsGateway whose recentWithin throws into collectXPosts; assert { items: [], perAccount: [] } and that collectRankSelect still ranks RSS items. Assert collectXPosts performs no live scrape (no scraper in its import graph).

tests/x/budgetCooldown.test.ts — stub gateways: exhausting maxSearchLoadsPerDay skips further search + logs; the same query within queryCooldownHours is skipped; a day-boundary key change resets counters; the escalating ladder 12->24->48 advances on repeats.

tests/x/learning.test.ts — upsertFromScrape only creates rows from scrape samples; promotion/demotion follow the thresholds; isOfficialAccount honors the officialMinCredibility gate and the pinnedHandles override.

tests/x/corroboration.test.ts (FIX #4) — build a CorroborationContext from mixed RSS+X items; an X post whose outboundUrls host matches an RSS url gets the RSS-match share; a group of >=2 promoted accounts sharing an outbound URL gets the multi-account share; include a MIXED-CASE host assertion (e.g. RSS https://TechCrunch.com/x vs X outbound https://techcrunch.com/x must corroborate via urlKey); assert the clusterId-equality path is gone (same-story X and RSS items with different clusterId still corroborate via URL).

tests/ras/payloadX.test.ts (FIX #2 payload) — an X-only story sets attributionLine 'per @handle on X', populates a NON-empty facts[] with sourceType 'x', and carries verified/claimRisk; an RSS story leaves X fields empty/default and still validates; assert `limited` is NOT forced true by signalOnly.
package.json — add all 8 new test files to the `test` script's explicit tsx --test file list.

src/mastra/demo/xDiscoveryDryRun.ts (x:discover:demo) — run runDiscovery over 3 topics with injected heuristic generateQueries (fixed strings), injected mock search/scrapeProfile returning synthetic enriched posts (INCLUDE one text_truncated post and one that triggers a simulated block), and stub gateways (zero network). Print queries generated, posts scraped, accounts discovered (with status), and write to a stub SavedXPostsGateway. Then run collectRankSelect with the heuristic ranker reading from that same stub and print the top-5 ranked WITH full breakdown (qualityScore, engagementComponent, engagementRatio, corroborationComponent, recencyMultiplier, penalties), plus truncated/blocked items.

src/mastra/demo/autoNewsDryRun.ts — extend to accept an injected savedPosts stub (mock-X path) and keep working feed-only when X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false (the single switch). Extend the heuristic RankGenerate stub to emit the 8 new LlmScore fields so items validate under the updated schema.

Run the full verification sequence in PowerShell (';' separator): `npm run typecheck` ; `npm run test` ; `$env:X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED="false"; npm run auto:dry` (feed-only) ; the mock-X auto:dry path ; `npm run x:discover:demo`. Fix any failures before writing the report.

Write c:\Users\sanav\OneDrive\Documents\GitHub\contentCreationAgent\.agents\pipeline\run-impl\06-final-report.md stating what is MOCKED (LLM query-gen, LLM ranking judgements, the Python scraper/search, all four gateways) vs REAL (scoring/filter/learning/corroboration math, schemas, payload builder, fact pack, cron wiring), listing all assumptions and resolutions, and CONFIRMING the hard constraints: posts nothing; INSTAGRAM_DRY_RUN/REQUIRE_APPROVAL default true; no git commit/push/config. Clean up any temporary files created during verification.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 new test files are registered in package.json and `npm run test` passes the full list (including the pre-existing suites).
`$env:X_DISCOVERY_ENABLED="false"; npm run auto:dry` runs feed-only (no X items) AND the mock-X auto:dry path runs with injected saved posts — both offline, nothing published.
`npm run x:discover:demo` prints queries generated, posts scraped, accounts discovered, top-5 ranked with full breakdown, and any truncated/blocked items — all offline.
06-final-report.md exists and confirms the hard constraints (posts nothing; DRY_RUN/REQUIRE_APPROVAL default true; no git).
findings:
